title: Heat exchanger control loop
goal: Show a closed negative-feedback temperature control loop.

rubric.must: Setpoint and measured sensor paths visibly meet at a summing junction with positive and negative inputs.
The plant output visibly passes through a sensor and returns to the summing junction.
Controller, actuator, and heat-exchanger plant form a readable forward control path.
Setpoint, temperature error, valve command, and negative-feedback labels are visible.
A separate operator display visibly receives the controlled outlet temperature.

ideal.notes: Refreshed against the September 15 exemplar: role fills, ink signal lines, 4 px block corners and restrained typography. Each target retains its own functional topology; generic blocks are not assigned inferred hardware roles.
